caption: The drawing features a single vase or urn centered on a plain, light beige background. The vase is predominantly brown with a reddish tone and has an ornate, symmetrical design. The neck of the vase is flared and slightly narrowed, with three elongated oval cutouts near the top. The main body of the vase is decorated with a central motif resembling a stylized flower arrangement or bouquet in a smaller vase, using yellow, gold, and green colors, surrounded by vine-like ornamental patterns. The base of the vase is wide, with three large cutouts, and tapers to create a stable support. The intricate decorations include leaves and scrolls in gold, olive, and light brown tones, providing contrast against the darker reddish-brown of the vase. The background is blank except for a few faint stains and light discoloration, keeping the focus on the central vase.
title: Inlaid Chippendale Chair Panel
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
